description: Doom-specific graph policy connecting raw proprioceptive/optic observations to PSI drives, dual-process candidates, and the existing ControlBundle. Python only copies measured state and enacts the graph-authored intent.

rules.name: doom_publish_network_mode_sample
rules.comment: Translate the current measured Doom observation into the generic graph-held network-mode vocabulary. All weighting and default-mode recruitment remain graph rules; the host publishes no mode decision.

rules.name: doom_score_intent_authorization
rules.comment: The host publishes consequence facts and a final completeness bit. The graph derives the same commit/wait/refine values used by the general information-commitment faculty; missing or partial descriptions remain proposed and therefore fail closed.

rules.name: doom_enacted_system_two_intent_opens_action_attempt
rules.comment: Local enactment authors a transport-pending eligibility record, not evidence that Doom applied the action. Only a lossless child-process receipt may open its causal observation window.

rules.name: doom_applied_receipt_opens_causal_window
rules.comment: Correlate a lossless applied receipt by action identity. The receipt's first graph-visible sensory epoch, not local enqueue time, starts the eligibility window.

rules.name: doom_expired_receipt_closes_without_learning
rules.comment: A pulse that the world never applied is a transport outcome, not negative evidence about the selected control.

rules.name: doom_action_attempt_closes_on_causal_success
rules.comment: A later measured benefit closes only the oldest eligible enacted attempt. One observation is consumed by at most one attempt, preventing a single kill or movement event from rewarding every outstanding action.

rules.name: doom_action_attempt_closes_on_failure_or_timeout
rules.comment: Respawn is immediate negative evidence. Mere absence of effect is not failure until the graph-held causal window expires, avoiding punishment of door motion and other delayed consequences.

rules.name: doom_archive_folded_outcome
rules.comment: Durable learned values live on Control. Before transient episode evidence ages out, retain a bounded aggregate count and mark the causal outcome safe for lifecycle pruning.
